subject: CPPO readiness: GigaCloud reseller entitlement & CPN integration
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Ruiz <anna@gigacloud.com>, Marco Li <marco.li@gigacloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO readiness: GigaCloud reseller entitlement & CPN integration

Hi Anna / Marco,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the time. Per our discussion I wanted to centralize the remaining items so we can hit the CPPO activation window next week. I attached an updated SKU mapping and a short onboarding checklist to this thread.

Can you please confirm the following by EOD Wednesday (your local time)?

1) SKU mapping validation: confirm which GigaCloud SKU(s) will map to the Redwood CPPO SKUs in column B of CPPO_Sku_Mapping_v2.xlsx (row-level notes are in the sheet).
2) Co-sell party number (CPN) integration: do you have a CPN for the sales team that will be associated with the listing? If so, share the intended CPN value and the contact (sales Ops owner).
3) Pricing floors: confirm whether GigaCloud requires a minimum margin (we discussed 20% threshold) and whether you need us to push a separate DocuSign amendment for pricing.
4) Invoicing & PO flow: who should we route vendor invoices to (email + AP contact)? We need this for Marketplace settlement mapping.
5) Marketing assets: can you confirm required co-branding assets and a short blurb for the listing page — we can draft but want to ensure you own approvals.

If anything needs sign-off from finance/legal on your side, flag and we can set a short call with Ben/Vanessa. Our goal is to submit the CPPO package to AWS by Friday so they can process within their SLA.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a one-page mutual action plan tomorrow.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments: CPPO_Sku_Mapping_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), Reseller_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Anna Ruiz <anna@gigacloud.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marco Li <marco.li@gigacloud.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 May 2028 13:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO readiness: GigaCloud reseller entitlement & CPN integration

Thanks Naomi — great summary. Internal note: looping Marco (sales ops) for the CPN and PO routing.

Quick answers below (covering items 1–4):

1) SKU mapping: confirmed for the first pass — we will use GC-SKU-RED-STD -> Redwood-CPPO-STD and GC-SKU-RED-PRO -> Redwood-CPPO-PRO. I annotated row comments in your spreadsheet and uploaded a small reconciliation sheet (will send if useful).
2) CPN: Marco is the owner; his CPN is CPN-7721. Marco, please confirm you can set that on the AWS listing and share the team email alias.
3) Pricing floors: GigaCloud requires a minimum 18% margin on listed price. That’s within the range we discussed; no DocuSign amendment needed if we keep to this floor.
4) Invoicing: route AP invoices to ap@gigacloud.com and cc invoices@gigacloud.com. Contact: Priya Shah (AP Manager) +1 206-555-0199.

We’ll draft the short blurb for the listing and send it by Thursday. Also attaching a brief reseller-side checklist.

—Anna
Anna Ruiz
Head of Partner GTM | GigaCloud Partners
anna@gigacloud.com | +1 206-555-0104

Attachments: GCP_Onboarding_Notes.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>, Anna Ruiz <anna@gigacloud.com>, Marco Li <marco.li@gigacloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO readiness: GigaCloud reseller entitlement & CPN integration

Thanks for the update Anna — that margin floor is acceptable. Two quick internal asks from our side before we push to AWS: 

- Legal: Vanessa, can you confirm whether the standard CPPO contract (we use the Marketplace listing T&Cs + resell addendum) needs any redlines for GigaCloud’s AP contact or for the pricing floor language? If not, we’ll proceed with our standard template.
- Finance: Priyom, please add ap@gigacloud.com to the vendor payout mapping and verify their EIN against the PO when we get it. Also confirm the invoice frequency they expect (monthly vs net-30).

Soojin — can you kick off the DocuSign PO template population and attach it to the HubSpot opportunity DEAL-9842 (link below)? I’ve added a note for payments team to expect the first invoice within 30–45 days of go-live.

If we get confirmations by EOD Thursday we can queue the CPPO submission to AWS on Friday morning. Naomi, if you want I’ll join the Friday send-off call with AWS.

-Ben
Director, Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Related HubSpot: https://hubspot.company.com/contacts/DEAL-9842

Date: Wed, 9 May 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO readiness: GigaCloud reseller entitlement & CPN integration

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick turns. Recap / action items (owner & ETA):

• Anna / Marco: finalize listing blurb + confirm team alias for CPN integration (ETA: Thu 5/10 EOD)
• Marco: confirm CPN is set to CPN-7721 on your side and share confirmation screenshot (ETA: Thu 5/10)
• Vanessa: legal to confirm no redlines on standard CPPO + resell addendum (ETA: Thu 5/10)
• Priyom: add GigaCloud AP to vendor mapping + confirm invoice cadence (ETA: Thu 5/10)
• Soojin: populate DocuSign PO template and attach to HubSpot DEAL-9842 (ETA: Thu 5/10)
• Ben: attend Friday AWS submit call (Fri 5/11 09:00 PT) and be on standby for any AWS request.

I’ll assemble the one-page mutual action plan and send it to this thread by tomorrow morning. If anything slips we’ll push the AWS submit window one business day, but the goal is to keep momentum and the co-sell timing intact.

Thanks — talk soon.
Naomi
